settings_ui_delete_current_kept2: Your Discord account and general session

settings_ui_request_warning: Once the file reaches your device, its security and sharing are entirely your responsibility. DiscoWeb is not responsible if you share it with third parties.
settings_ui_request_ack: I have read the responsibility notice and approve sending the data file via DM.
settings_ui_request_error: An error occurred while requesting data. Please try again.
settings_ui_request_error_dm: Data could not be sent. Please make sure “Allow direct messages from server members” is enabled on your Discord account.
settings_ui_request_success: Your personal data was compiled and sent to you as a Direct Message (DM)!

settings_ui_delete_modal_body_current: Scope is limited. After confirmation, only Activity records for this server are removed.
settings_ui_delete_no_backups: Backups cannot be accessed; the process starts immediately upon confirmation.
settings_ui_delete_ack_all: I understand this action is permanent and irreversible, and I confirm deletion.
settings_ui_delete_ack_current: I understand that only data for this server will be deleted, and I confirm.
settings_ui_delete_error: An error occurred while deleting data. Please try again.
settings_ui_delete_success_all: All of your data has been deleted.
settings_ui_delete_success_current: Your server data has been deleted. Refreshing the page...
settings_ui_deleted_body: Your DiscoWeb Activity data has been permanently removed. You can close this window.
